evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members.
Fees and expenses would be paid separately, subject to court approval
We propose a $33 million class fund and $5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval.

summary: Plaintiff first raised attorneys’ fees in its opening public term sheet, before class relief was settled. Fees and class relief were negotiated in the same pre-acceptance exchange, but the transcript does not clearly show a tradeoff of class recovery for fees, self-interested class-counsel reasoning, defense fee leverage, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
